remarks: Welcome to 24736 Kings Road, a beautifully upgraded single-level home offering over 3,000 square feet and ideally situated at the end of a cul-de-sac in Laguna Niguel. Featuring five bedrooms plus a den/office, the home offers a thoughtfully designed open floor plan with an effortless flow between the living, dining, and entertaining spaces. The beautifully appointed chef’s kitchen opens seamlessly to the main living areas, while thoughtful upgrades and finishes throughout create a sophisticated yet comfortable feel. Designed to embrace Southern California indoor-outdoor living, the home sits on an expansive 11,000+ square-foot lot with a spacious backyard surrounded by lush greenery.
